import itertools
def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0]); bands=[I[b*3:(b+1)*3] for b in range(4)]
    sols=[]
    for sh in itertools.product(range(W),repeat=4):
        pred=[[None]*W for _ in range(3)]
        for r in range(3):
            vals=[(b, bands[b][r][(c+sh[b])%W]) for b in range(4)]
            nz=[(b,v) for b,v in vals if v!=0]
            if len(nz)==1: pred[r][nz[0][1]]=nz[0][1]
        ok=all(True for _ in [])
        # consistency: same (r,c) not claimed by two different nonzero bands
        dups=[]
        for r in range(3):
            for c in range(W):
                nz=[(b,v) for b in range(4) if bands[b][r][(c+sh[b])%W]!=0]
                if len(nz)>1 and len({v for b,v in nz})>1: dups.append((r,c,nz)); break
        if dups: continue
        sols.append((sum(1 for r in range(3) for c in range(W) if pred[r][c] is not None), tuple(map(tuple,pred))))
    if not sols: return [[0]*W for _ in range(3)]
    cov,T=max(sols)[1:]
    return [list(r) for r in T]
for k in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    o=solve(G[k+' input']); e=G[k+' output']
    print(k, o==e)
    if o!=e:
        for r in range(3): print(o[r],e[r])
